title: A light below the hill
description: The surveyor has left a newly charted entrance. Accept the commission to receive your first map, then investigate it at your own pace.

title: Three floors down
description: Reach the third floor of any grotto. Old maps count too. Return here with your findings for another chart.

title: Teeth in the dark
description: Defeat five wandering monsters while this commission is active.

title: What the stone keeps
description: Open three grotto chests. Chests replenish on a new expedition; their positions and ranks stay fixed.

title: Beyond the familiar
description: Reach floor six. Compare your maps and seek a deeper site.

title: A keeper's collection
description: Defeat three grotto bosses after accepting this commission. Revisiting an old favourite is welcome.
